title: Shared definitions
description: Encodings with one valid spelling each (docs/specs/vaos-2.0.md section 7 and docs/specs/transparency-log.md section 3.6).

hash.description: A SHA-256 hash: 32 bytes as exactly 64 lowercase hex digits.

count.description: A leaf index or tree size: an integer from 0 to 2^53 - 1.

v2Signature.description: v2= and a 64-byte Ed25519 signature in canonical padded standard base64: 86 characters, the last with zero padding bits, then ==.
